transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… I’m having trouble keeping my head on things. At work, doing inventory, or when I try to study for a supervisor certification, I keep rereading the same line or forgetting why I went to the supply closet. It’s been getting in the way.
Have you been feeling anxious or overwhelmed when these episodes of forgetfulness happen?
I don’t know… not really anxious, I guess. Maybe frustrated when it happens. I haven’t paid that much attention to it.
Do you often find yourself easily distracted by things around you?

Yeah… I guess so. It’s more like my head just doesn’t stay with what I’m doing. I’ll be checking inventory or trying to study, and I realize I’ve read the same line a few times, or I’m standing in the supply closet not remembering what I came in for.
Do you often find yourself fidgeting or feeling restless?
I don’t think so. I mean, I shift around sometimes, but I haven’t really noticed feeling restless like that.
Do you often feel like you're moving or tapping your hands or feet when you're sitting still?
Not that I’ve noticed. I mean, maybe once in a while, but I don’t think it’s a regular thing.
Do you have trouble focusing or making mistakes in your personal life, like when you're doing chores or hobbies?

Yeah… mostly with chores and studying. I’ll start something and then just lose track of what I was doing. Like with inventory, or when I’m trying to study for the supervisor certification, I keep rereading the same line. Sometimes I’ll go to the supply closet and forget why I went in there.
Do you often feel like you're constantly on the go or have an inability to engage in activities quietly?
Not really. I can sit still okay most of the time. I don’t think I’m constantly on the go or anything like that.
Do you think your trouble with focusing and remembering what you're doing is related to feeling stressed or upset about something?

Maybe. I don’t know if it’s stress exactly. It’s more like my head just won’t stay on what I’m doing… like with inventory or studying, I’ll read the same line over and over, or go to the supply closet and forget why I went there.
Have you experienced any significant periods of extreme mood swings, either very high or very low, in the past few months?

Not really high, no. Low, yeah… most days it’s like this heavy, flat feeling that just follows me around. Even at work, just pushing the cart down an empty hallway, or sitting with my family trying to act normal.
Can you tell me more about this heavy, flat feeling you mentioned, how often do you experience it?

It’s… most days, I guess. It’s just this heavy, kind of flat feeling that follows me around. Like even doing normal stuff, pushing the cart down the hall at work, or sitting with my family trying to act normal… it’s still there.
How long have you been experiencing this heavy, flat feeling?
About three years, I think. It started around when the contractor moved us onto those rotating evening and overnight shifts at the bigger properties.
Does this heavy, flat feeling stop you from doing things you want or need to do?

Yeah… somewhat. I mean, I still get the cleaning done, but it takes me longer than it should. I keep rechecking the logs and second-guessing myself.

And I’ve kind of… stopped putting myself forward for the supervisor track. Outside work, I skip stuff more now—neighborhood clean-ups, family get-togethers. Things I used to make time for.
Do you find that you're not enjoying things you used to enjoy, like hobbies or spending time with family and friends?
I don’t know… maybe a little. I still do some things, I guess, but they don’t really feel the same. I don’t think about it much.
Are there things you used to enjoy doing that you no longer find pleasure in?
I’m not really sure. I mean… maybe some things feel kind of dull now, but I don’t know if I’d say I don’t enjoy them at all. I just don’t think about it much.
Have you felt this heavy, flat feeling almost every day for the past three years?
Yeah… pretty much. It’s been about three years, I think. Around when they switched us to those rotating evening and overnight shifts at the bigger properties.
Are there activities that you used to find pleasurable but no longer do?
I don’t really know. I still do things sometimes, but it’s hard to tell if I’m enjoying them less or if I’m just… not paying much attention to it.
Are there things that you used to enjoy doing, but now you don't enjoy them at all?
I don’t know if there’s anything I’d say I don’t enjoy at all. It’s more like… I don’t really notice much one way or the other.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight over the past few months?
Not that I’ve really noticed. My clothes fit about the same, I think.
Are there things that used to bring you pleasure, but now feel completely unenjoyable?
I don’t think I’d say completely unenjoyable. It’s more like I just don’t really… get much out of things, or I don’t pay attention to it. Hard to say.
Have you felt a lack of interest in activities that used to bring you pleasure for most of the day, nearly every day, for the past three years?

I’m not sure. Three years is a long time to sort out like that. I guess I haven’t paid close attention… I wouldn’t say I’m interested in much, but I don’t know about “most of the day, nearly every day.”
